PC 2024 D-E1 card of [[Hindsight]]: A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (27 January 2024). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Supplement (29 January 2002). Source: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7fe33eb3c3a3ba65e4b799e1362e64d90dd820e7 swccgpc/holotable commit 7fe33eb], 27 January 2024: card image hindsight.gif. Shown on [[Hindsight (PC 2024 D-E1 card)]].
